label: caiso 53 lever ab
definition: (PROBE) caiso 53 lever-ab: tests the two FINDING-caiso-evening-merit levers on the full caiso-51 recipe. LEVER A (offer physics): CC_REGULAR/CC_CHP committed band 0.90/0.92x -> 1.00x plant-avg HR — the min-stable-load block's SRMC floor; restores committed >= econ_low ordering (econ_low held at the CAMPD-measured 0.95/0.96). LEVER B (measured market input): firm import-tranche VOLUMES grounded on DMM Annual Report RA-import capacity (CAISO BAA boundary: 2,323 MW 2023 / 3,371 MW 2024 / 2025 carries 2024 — open gap until the DMM 2025 annual report) split by published MIC branch-group share north/south of Path 15: per-year firm blocks 1072/1251, 1558/1813, 1566/1805 MW (was uncited 800/1800). RESULTS vs keeper caiso-51 — the targeted CC/import complex improves: C1 2023 CC_REGULAR now PASSES (was +4.91 TWh), 2024 +9.43 TWh (was +10.86); net import 2024 30.0 vs 32.4 TWh actual (was 25.8), 2025 38.0 vs 36.2 (was 32.3); evening corridors net-IMPORT (DSW +1213 / PNW +543 MW h15-21; the evening-export artifact is gone); C5a 2024 passes (was +8.5%); C7 CT diurnal largely fixed — 2023+2024 CT_PEAKER pass, flat-floor CV signature 0.03-0.06 -> 2.6-3.1 (2025 CT fails on profile r 0.682 only; ST_GAS 2024/2025 still fail). The flagged price tension lands as expected: C3a worsens to +22.3/+37.9/+48.9% (Lever A reprices the committed band), C3b 0.303/0.488/0.502, C2 2025 gas +10.5% (was +8.1%). NEW ROOT-CAUSE ITEMS (logged, not chased): (1) 2023 C3c tail 454h >$200 vs 21h actual — Jan-2023-concentrated (513/525h): the measured $28/MMBtu citygate spike x the repriced committed CC (~$213) now crosses $200 while actual held below — monthly-average gas overlay too blunt in spike months and/or missing demand response; (2) C8 CT forced share 65-76% (was 29-33% lower-bound): forced TWh is flat (~all ct_netload_drag, 1.17-1.29 TWh) but MERIT CT energy collapsed 2.3 -> 0.6 TWh as grounded imports displace marginal CT — the drag floor now IS the CT class, confirming the FINDING's structural ramp/local gap (separate session; no floor may close it, rules #1/17-20). NOT promoted: C7 improves but C8's gated share worsens — does not beat caiso-51 on C7/C8 jointly. Both levers are grounded inputs (rule #15) and stay in code; caiso-51 remains keeper. DOF ledger: +cc_committed_hr_mult_floor (measured-physical), +caiso_firm_import_volumes (measured-market); IMPORT_TRANCHES firm volumes re-identified, n_residual 8 -> 7.
